---
title: "`r params$species`"
params:
  species: null
  output_dir: null
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

sp <- params$species
csv_dir <- file.path(params$output_dir, "csv")
# This page is rendered to `output_dir/species/<species>.html`, while its
# PNG/HTML plots were written by `evaluate()` to
# `output_dir/plots/<species>/` - a sibling of `species/`, hence `..`.
plots_dir <- file.path("..", "plots", sp)

read_csv_safe <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  csv_df <- utils::read.csv(
    path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE
  )
  if (nrow(csv_df) == 0) NULL else csv_df
}

dt <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(htmltools::tags$p(htmltools::em("No data.")))
  }
  DT::datatable(
    df,
    rownames = FALSE,
    filter = "top",
    options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE)
  )
}

tag_class <- c(Critical = "tag-critical", Warning = "tag-warning", Improved = "tag-ok") # nolint: line_length_linter

# Renders `items` as colored pill badges, echoing the colored lists `cli`
# prints to the console for the same critical/warning groupings.
tag_list <- function(items, status) {
  if (length(items) == 0) {
    return('<span class="tag-empty">None</span>')
  }
  paste(
    sprintf('<span class="tag %s">%s</span>', tag_class[[status]], items),
    collapse = " "
  )
}

species_stats <- read_csv_safe(file.path(csv_dir, "species_stats.csv"))
rrmse_comparison <- read_csv_safe(
  file.path(csv_dir, "species_rrmse_comparison.csv")
)
failed_usms <- read_csv_safe(file.path(csv_dir, "failed_usms.csv"))
deteriorated_usm <- read_csv_safe(file.path(csv_dir, "Deteriorated_USM.csv"))
usm_thresholds <- read_csv_safe(file.path(csv_dir, "usm_thresholds.csv"))

# Mirrors `RRmseComparison$critical_vars`/`warning_vars` (and thus what
# `SpeciesEvaluation$summary()` prints, and which variables get a scatter
# plot below): `status` alone isn't enough, `n_obs > 10` is also required.
sp_comp <- if (!is.null(rrmse_comparison)) {
  rrmse_comparison[rrmse_comparison$species == sp, , drop = FALSE]
}
sp_failed_usms <- if (!is.null(failed_usms)) {
  failed_usms$situation[failed_usms$species == sp]
}
sp_deteriorated <- if (!is.null(deteriorated_usm)) {
  deteriorated_usm[deteriorated_usm$species == sp, , drop = FALSE]
}

# Scatter plot files for this species live under `plots_dir`. Ordered from
# most to least degraded using `sp_comp`'s rRMSE ratio (falls back to
# filesystem order - alphabetical by variable - if that data isn't
# available).
scatter_paths <- Sys.glob(file.path(plots_dir, "*_scatter_plot.html"))
scatter_vars <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(scatter_paths))
scatter_vars <- sub("_scatter_plot$", "", scatter_vars)

ratio <- rep(NA_real_, length(scatter_vars))
has_ratio <- !is.null(sp_comp) && "rrmse_ratio" %in% names(sp_comp)
if (has_ratio) {
  ratio <- sp_comp$rrmse_ratio[match(scatter_vars, sp_comp$variable)]
}
ord <- order(-ifelse(is.na(ratio), -Inf, ratio))
scatter_paths <- scatter_paths[ord]
scatter_vars <- scatter_vars[ord]
```

```{=html}
<style>
.tag {
  display: inline-block; padding: 0.15em 0.7em; margin: 0.15em 0.25em 0.15em 0; # nolint: line_length_linter
  border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.9em; font-weight: 600;
}
.tag-critical { background: #fdecea; color: #c0392b; }
.tag-warning { background: #fef5e7; color: #b9770e; }
.tag-ok { background: #eafaf1; color: #1e8449; }
.tag-empty { color: #888; font-style: italic; }
</style>
```

## Variables

### Degraded variables

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (is.null(sp_comp)) {
  cat("::: {.callout-note}\nNo comparison done.\n:::\n\n")
} else {
  # Mirrors `RRmseComparison$critical_vars`/`warning_vars`/`improved_vars`
  # (and thus what `SpeciesEvaluation$summary()` prints to the console, and
  # which variables get a scatter plot below): `status` alone isn't enough,
  # `n_obs > 10` is also required.
  reliable <- sp_comp[sp_comp$n_obs > 10, ]
  by_status <- split(reliable$variable, reliable$status)
  cat(sprintf(
    "<p><strong>%d variable(s) critical</strong> (major rRMSE increase)<br>\n%s</p>\n", # nolint: line_length_linter
    length(by_status[["Critical"]]),
    tag_list(by_status[["Critical"]], "Critical")
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "<p><strong>%d variable(s) warning</strong> (minor rRMSE increase)<br>\n%s</p>\n", # nolint: line_length_linter
    length(by_status[["Warning"]]),
    tag_list(by_status[["Warning"]], "Warning")
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "<p><strong>%d variable(s) improved</strong> (rRMSE stable or improved)<br>\n%s</p>\n", # nolint: line_length_linter
    length(by_status[["Improved"]]),
    tag_list(by_status[["Improved"]], "Improved")
  ))
}
```

### Statistics (all situations)

```{r}
#| echo: false
dt(species_stats[species_stats$species == sp, , drop = FALSE])
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
comparison_path <- file.path(plots_dir, "species_comparison.png")
if (file.exists(comparison_path)) {
  cat("### Comparison plot\n\n")
  cat(sprintf(
    '<img src="%s" style="max-width:100%%; border:1px solid #ddd;">\n\n', # nolint: line_length_linter
    comparison_path
  ))
  cat(paste0(
    "::: {.callout-note}\n",
    "Why some variables above have no scatter plot below: a variable ",
    "is colored Critical or Warning here as soon as its species-level ",
    "rRMSE ratio crosses the threshold, but the evaluation system ",
    "additionally requires more than 10 observations (`n_obs > 10`) ",
    "before flagging a variable as deteriorated. A variable with fewer ",
    "observations can still show up as Critical or Warning above, but ",
    "won't get an individual scatter plot below - it isn't considered ",
    "statistically reliable enough to trigger one.\n",
    ":::\n\n"
  ))
}

if (length(scatter_paths) > 0) {
  cat("### Scatter plots\n\n")
}
for (i in seq_along(scatter_paths)) {
  cat(sprintf("#### %s\n\n", scatter_vars[i]))
  cat(sprintf(
    '<iframe src="%s" style="width:100%%; height:450px; border:none;"></iframe>\n\n', # nolint: line_length_linter
    scatter_paths[i]
  ))
}
```

## USMs

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (!is.null(failed_usms)) {
  cat("### Failed USMs\n\n")
  explanation <- if (!is.null(usm_thresholds)) {
    sprintf(
      paste(
        "A USM (situation) is flagged as **failed** if at least one of",
        "these holds, for at least one variable on that USM (with more",
        "than 10 observations):\n\n",
        "- its rRMSE ratio vs. the reference version exceeds",
        "**%s%%** (the *critical* threshold), or\n",
        "- **more than %s variables** on that USM individually exceed a",
        "lower **%s%%** *degraded* threshold.\n"
      ),
      usm_thresholds$ratio_threshold, usm_thresholds$max_degraded_vars,
      usm_thresholds$degraded_threshold
    )
  } else {
    paste(
      "A USM (situation) is flagged as **failed** if at least one",
      "variable on that USM crosses a critical rRMSE ratio threshold, or",
      "if too many variables individually cross a lower degradation",
      "threshold.\n"
    )
  }
  cat(sprintf("<p>%s</p>\n\n", tag_list(sp_failed_usms, "Critical")))
  cat(paste0("::: {.callout-note}\n", explanation, ":::\n\n"))
}
```
